name: Dual On/Off Outlet
description: The on/off outlet with two separately controlled outlets, which runs the KeypadLinc code base with load sense for each outlet.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: secondLoadSense
operatingFlags.description: Load sense is on for the bottom outlet, group 2.

operatingFlags.name: loadSense
operatingFlags.description: Load sense is on for the top outlet, group 1.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the power line is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: smartHops
operatingFlags.description: Each message starts with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops). When the bit is 0, each message starts with one hop.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: ledBrightness
values.description: The brightness of the status LED, from 0x11 (dimmest) to 0x7F (brightest).

writes.name: x10Address
writes.description: Sets the X10 address of the top outlet (D1 0x01) or the bottom outlet (D1 0x02).

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LED.

parameter.name: state
parameter.description: 0x00 turns the top outlet off; 0x01 through 0xFF turn it on.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the top outlet's level. The acknowledgement's cmd1 carries the link database delta.

standardCommands.name: readOutlets
standardCommands.description: Reads which outlets are on. The acknowledgement's cmd1 carries the link database delta.

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once, as pressing the set button does. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: groupOn
standardCommands.description: Turns on an outlet as a group On would.

standardCommands.name: groupOff
standardCommands.description: Turns off an outlet as a group Off would.

extendedCommands.name: bottomOutletOn
extendedCommands.description: Turns the bottom outlet on. Any cmd2 from 0x01 through 0xFF turns it on, and 0x00 off.

notes: Insteon's earliest command sheet swaps 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the later sheets, used here, agree with the Insteon for Hub app.
Insteon's 2009 Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but the later command sheets read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.
Insteon's 2009 Developer's Guide gives query 0x02 as a signal-to-noise value; the later command sheets count messages with CRC errors there.

The 2663-222 guide marks bit 0 of the 0x05 reply reserved and lists no Set Operating Flags 0x10 or 0x11, so the application retries flag is left out; the command workbook gives it for the KeypadLinc code base.
The 2663-222 guide gives bit 4 of the 0x05 reply as the button lock; the command workbook gives 0x18 to lock the buttons and 0x19 to unlock them.
